question: Does a candidate persistent-memory architecture improve adaptation to unseen teammates beyond ordinary recurrent capacity, and does an added update controller provide a separate increment?
claim_boundary: Proposed experiments only. No native MARL code, qualified adapter, registered run or efficacy result is supplied.

initial_task.observation: native full-screen image; no privileged phase or teammate ID
initial_task.reward: prespecified mean of the two identical native rewards per joint transition, not their duplicated sum
initial_task.reason: Two fixed roles permit explicit cross-play pairing and interface checks. Full-screen single-frame observations do not prove a need for a sophisticated memory; include two-frame and ordinary-GRU controls.
initial_task.ctde_limit: On this task the available global screen may offer little extra information over local actor observation; use it for pipeline checks, not proof of centralized-credit advantage.
initial_task.next_task: Only after qualification, select a task that directly tests the missing information/coordination mechanism; SMACv2 is a reference candidate requiring a separate design.

execution_actor: fixed role identity if included for all methods
its own past action and received reward if included for all methods
diagnostics_only: teammate snapshot source and training seed
information_contract.communication: No extra message channel in the initial task; adding one is a new factor with explicit bit/round/delay budgets.

independent_units.unit: independently initialized complete trained team or jointly generated learning population
not_independent: episodes from one trained policy pair
cells sharing the same focal or teammate policy
independent_units.crossplay_uncertainty: Retain source-team identities and account for crossed row/column dependence. Basic rlworkbench compare does not implement this estimator.

tests: isolated evaluation RNG and hidden state
stages.advance_if: All contracts checked and ordinary controls solve the chosen setting; otherwise revise the task or adapter.

stages.fixed_training_regime: Select and freeze one qualified learning method using independent development evidence before the mechanism study.
stages.advance_if: Candidate improves the prespecified unseen-partner endpoint with old-partner noninferiority and measured resource limits.

stages.depends_on: A qualified memory experiment with a measurable failure mode.
stages.interpretation: Team credit, network-module credit and learning-program credit are separate estimands. Test the architecture-controller interaction rather than assigning all improvement to meta-learning.

proposed_budget_example.status: illustrative planning numbers, not registered or a power recommendation
proposed_budget_example.confirmation_team_seeds: choose after development variance and minimum-effect analysis; use an untouched population
proposed_budget_example.partner_generation_cost: Budget separately for every trained snapshot source and reuse it equally across candidate arms.
proposed_budget_example.evaluation_cost: Lock pool size, pair matrix, episodes per pair, episode caps and joint-step cap before training. Never choose checkpoints using the final cross-play pool.
proposed_budget_example.churn_schedule: In the continuing-adaptation panel only, propose switches at 25%, 50%, 75% of a lifetime, with the final interval revisiting the original partner. The schedule is researcher-only; the frozen zero-shot panel is separate.

evaluation_panels.name: frozen_crossplay
evaluation_panels.population: all preregistered left-role policy i x right-role policy j combinations, with off-diagonal cells reported separately
evaluation_panels.role_rule: Keep role identity; do not assume asymmetric paddles are exchangeable.

evaluation_panels.name: frozen_unseen_teammates
evaluation_panels.population: untouched partner seeds/algorithms chosen before final evaluation

evaluation_panels.name: continual_partner_changes
evaluation_panels.state_rule: Preserve focal state over unannounced switches. Any partner-state or environment reset must be explicit and matched across arms.

evaluation_panels.name: old_partner_revisit
evaluation_panels.learning: frozen recall then separately budgeted relearning
evaluation_panels.population: original partner identities from the prespecified lifetime schedule

measures.primary: Set exactly one complete-lifetime team-return or fixed-pool cross-play estimand before registration; these answer different questions.
secondary: full cross-play matrix with role labels
post-switch cumulative loss and prespecified recovery rule
parameters, persistent bytes, peak memory, actor latency, training compute
joint transitions, per-agent actions, partner training, planning queries and communication costs
unsupported_claims: Nash equilibrium from a win-rate table
memory necessity from one pixel task

stop_or_revise_if: Privileged teammate identity or phase reaches an execution actor.
Candidate only beats a smaller or cheaper baseline.
Self-play improves while held-out cross-play deteriorates beyond the registered tolerance.
Only a post-hoc checkpoint or subset of partners produces a gain.
Extra partner training, planning or message cost exceeds the matched budget.
The task does not distinguish the intended mechanism; do not add complexity solely to chase score.

external_producer_mapping.job_unit: one independent team or learning-population lifetime
external_producer_mapping.steps: registered joint-world transition total across all vector environments
external_producer_mapping.receipt: Follow docs/external-adapters.md; result/producer placeholders are not measurement evidence.

before_executable_protocol: Implement and test a version-pinned adapter.
Resolve all REQUIRED fields, exact controls, total development/confirmation budgets and power rationale.
Freeze partner generation, evaluation populations, metrics and failure handling.
Create a separate external protocol and lock; this planning JSON is intentionally not a protocol.
